journal.jtype.meaning: use this column when ever asked about open access journals and subcription journals

journal.new_mps_journal.meaning: Whether the journal is live on the new MPS publishing platform.

journal.submission_link.meaning: Whether the manuscript submission link is turned on or off for this journal.

journal.is_visible.meaning: Whether the journal is shown or hidden on the public-facing site.

journal.journal_sale.meaning: Whether the journal is marked as for-sale.

journal.sale_journal_ppv.meaning: For a sale journal, whether the pay-per-view price is displayed to readers.

journal.published.meaning: Whether the journal record has been published.

journal.journal_status.meaning: Overall active/inactive status of the journal record.

journal.continues_publication_journal.meaning: Whether the journal follows a volume-based continuous-publication (CP) model, as opposed to discrete issues.

journal.IsIssue.meaning: Whether the journal publishes in discrete issues (as opposed to continuous publication).

journal.cp_issue_journal.meaning: For continuous-publication journals, whether the journal is also organized into issues.
